newsitem.title: MALI: SOCCER-MALI SACK NATIONAL COACH AFTER CUP FAILURE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MALI SACK NATIONAL COACH AFTER CUP FAILURE.

text.p: Mali have sacked their national soccer coach Mamadou Keita after the national team, the Eagles, failed to reach the finals of next year's African Nations' Cup.
The sports minister and the head of the Malian Football Federation announced the decision in a statement late on Monday after the team lost 4-2 to Ivory Coast in a weekend qualifier.
Keita coached the team during the 1980s and was recalled in 1993. In 1994, he took the side to the semifinals of the Nations Cup after beating hosts Tunisia in the opening match.
